title: Insurance Product Manager (All Genders)
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION** 
**Insurance Product Manager**
Excited by the opportunity to build innovative digital retail banking products and services in a start-up environment, backed by one of the leading financial service providers worldwide?
Join our digital consumer banking offer Chase at our new JPMorganChase office in the heart of Berlin. In this exciting chapter of continued growth and expansion, we're looking for a passionate Product Manager.
People want great value combined with an excellent experience from a bank they can trust – so we launched our digital bank, Chase. Already trusted by millions of customers in the US, we're growing rapidly in markets including the UK and Germany. We're building the bank of the future from scratch, channelling a start-up mentality every step of the way, and you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact.
As an Product Manager at JPMorganChase within the International Consumer Bank, you will help protect our customers by owning regulated insurance distribution in Germany. This is a hands-on product delivery role, working across Product, Technology, Legal, Risk, Compliance and external providers to translate complex regulatory requirements into clear product requirements and drive them through to successful delivery.
While professional skills matter, culture is just as important. We believe diversity of thought, experiences and backgrounds makes good teams great. By bringing different points of view together, we build products that better reflect the communities we serve – creating scope for you to make a real difference.
**Job responsibilities:**
* Act as the designated qualified individual responsible for regulated insurance distribution in the relevant market(s), accountable for ongoing compliance, governance and distribution readiness.
* Own the insurance experience and roadmap, balancing customer outcomes, local market needs, regulatory obligations, controls and technology constraints.
* Translate market and regulatory needs into clear requirements and acceptance criteria, partnering with Design, Content, Technology, Legal, Risk and Compliance to deliver solutions that are desirable, usable, feasible and viable.
* Lead end-to-end delivery with internal teams and external partners, coordinating stakeholders, managing dependencies and timelines, and being accountable for outcomes.
* Assure compliant distribution by owning and signing off regulated customer journeys and material changes, ensuring legal obligations are met and evidenced through a consistent customer experience.
* Own the distribution operating model and controls, validate control effectiveness and auditability, monitor performance, and drive issue management and service improvement.
* Confirm operational readiness for launch and change, including entity and licensing/registration alignment (where applicable), responsible personnel readiness, partner readiness, and the ability to require remediation, reject changes or suspend distribution where regulatory concerns arise.
**Required qualifications, capabilities and skills:**
* Candidates must be able to evidence statutory professional competence (“Sachkunde”) for insurance intermediation/advice in Germany and be able to provide documentation evidencing competence and any required practical experience.
* Expertise must be evidenced via a recognised route, including the IHK competence examination, BWV qualification, or a recognised equivalent professional qualification under VersVermV §5.
* 5+ years in product management (or equivalent) with meaningful time in platform products.
* Proven ability to translate technical concepts into product outcomes, aligning engineering execution to measurable customer impact.
* Experience running discovery and prioritisation with multiple stakeholder groups and competing priorities; excellent judgment on trade-offs.
* A track record of delivery against a product roadmap (including working with engineering teams and key partners).
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and explain decisions clearly, logically, empathetically but firmly, including senior stakeholders and control partners.
* Strong written and verbal communication; able to create requirements, roadmaps, and exec-ready updates that are concise and actionable.
**Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills**
* Experience delivering digital insurance products and working with insurance providers.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex, enterprise-scale technology implementations.
When you work at JPMorganChase, you're not just working at a global financial institution. You're an integral part of one of the world's biggest tech companies. In 20 technology centres worldwide, our team of 50,000 technologists design, build and deploy everything from enterprise technology initiatives to big data and mobile solutions, as well as innovations in electronic payments, cybersecurity, machine learning, and cloud development. Our $10B+ annual investment in technology enables us to hire people to create innovative solutions that are transforming the financial services industry.
At JPMorganChase, we value the unique skills of every employee, and we're building a technology organisation that thrives on diversity. We encourage professional growth and career development, and offer competitive benefits and compensation. If you're looking to build your career as part of a global technology team tackling big challenges that impact the lives of people and companies all around the world, we want to meet you.
JPMorganChase offers an exceptional benefits programme and a highly competitive compensation package.
JPMorganChase is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
**#ICBCareer**
**ABOUT US**
J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients

title: Product Manager:in (alle Identitäten)
description:
#### **Das erwartet Dich**
Caspar Health ist führend in der digitalen Reha-Nachsorge. Wir verbinden moderne Technologie mit echter Menschlichkeit, damit Patient:innen nach einem Klinikaufenthalt nachhaltig gesund bleiben und Therapeut:innen spürbar entlastet werden.
Weil unser Produkt stetig wächst und wir die Arbeitslast im Produktmanagement auf weitere starke Schultern verteilen möchten, suchen wir dich für unsere *Patient Squad*. Gemeinsam mit einem schlagkräftigen Team übernimmst du schrittweise die End-to-End-Verantwortung für einen zentralen Bereich unserer Patient:innen-Anwendung. Was diese Rolle so besonders macht? Du fährst direkt in Partnerkliniken, schaust Patient:innen und Therapeut:innen über die Schulter und übersetzt echte Beobachtungen in messbare Produktverbesserungen.
Wir schätzen deine Expertise und möchten den Gehaltsrahmen für diese Position transparent mit dir teilen. Dein Einstiegsgehalt orientiert sich an deiner Qualifikation, deinem Skill-Set, deiner einschlägigen Berufserfahrung sowie der Marktsituation. Die Vergütung für diese Position erfolgt gemäß unserer Gehaltsbänder und liegt zwischen **57.500** € und **63.000** € brutto pro Jahr (bei Vollzeit 40h).
**Diese Rolle passt zu dir, wenn du…**
* **Gestalten statt abarbeiten willst:** Du steuerst Discovery und Priorisierung selbst und siehst direkt, wie deine Arbeit Patient:innen im Alltag hilft.
* **Evidenz & AI smart verbindest:** Du triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis echter Klinik-Insights und moderner AI-Workflows – in einem sicheren, verlässlichen HealthTech-Umfeld.
* **Augenhöhe statt Egos suchst:** Du bringst Design, Tech und Medizin im Product Trio zusammen – in einem Team, in dem gute Argumente zählen und man sich gegenseitig den Rücken stärkt.
#### **Deine Herausforderungen**
* **Produkt-Discovery & echte Klinik-Insights:** Eigenständige Planung von Nutzerforschung, Analytics und Experimenten – inklusive 1–2 Klinikbesuchen pro Quartal, bei denen du live miterlebst, wie Patient:innen und Therapeut:innen unsere App nutzen, und daraus direkt spürbare Verbesserungen ableitest
* **Outcome-orientierte Priorisierung mit Gestaltungsmacht:** Definition von Zielen, Roadmaps und User Stories auf Augenhöhe im Product Trio – damit du und dein Team nicht einfach Tickets abarbeiten, sondern an den Themen bauen, die den größten Unterschied machen
* **End-to-End-Verantwortung & sichtbarer Erfolg:** Begleitung von Features von der ersten Idee bis zum Live-Gang – inklusive Erfolgsmessung mit dem Data-Team und cleveren Testplänen, damit du den messbaren Impact deiner eigenen Entscheidungen Schwarz auf Weiß siehst
* **AI-first Produktarbeit als Produktivitäts-Turbo:** Aktiver und kritischer Einsatz moderner KI-Tools in Discovery, Dokumentation und Entscheidungsfindung – so baust du AI-Skills aus und hältst dir den Rücken frei für echte strategische Produktarbeit
* **Regulatorik & Security mit Sinn:** Integration von Datenschutz- und Sicherheitsstandards (DSGVO, ISO 27001, ISO 13485) in deine Produktentscheidungen, um gemeinsam mit Tech smarte Lösungen zu finden, die sensible Gesundheitsdaten verlässlich schützen
* **Transparentes Stakeholder-Management:** Offener und rechtzeitiger Austausch über Ziele, Prioritäten und Risiken mit deinem und angrenzenden Teams – so sorgt ihr gemeinsam für Klarheit und haltet euch bei komplexen Themen gegenseitig den Rücken frei
#### **Dein Profil**
* **Praxiserfahrung im Produktmanagement:** Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Betreuung eines digitalen Produkts oder Feature-Bereichs in einem agilen Team – idealerweise mit ersten messbaren Discovery-Erfolgen
* **Strukturierte, evidenzbasierte Arbeitsweise:** Ausgeprägtes Produkturteil, Datenaffinität und ein gründliches Test-Mindset, um auch in dynamischen Phasen den Überblick zu behalten
* **Kommunikationsstärke & Reflexionsfähigkeit:** Klare Moderation zwischen Design, Tech und Medizin – gepaart mit der Offenheit, Annahmen zu hinterfragen und rechtzeitig Unterstützung einzufordern
* **Routine mit KI-Workflows:** Sicherer Umgang mit KI- und Automatisierungstools im Arbeitsalltag sowie ein kritisches Auge für deren verantwortungsvollen Einsatz
* **Empathie & Qualitätsbewusstsein:** Echtes Interesse an den Bedürfnissen von Patient:innen und Therapeut:innen sowie ein hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein für Datenschutz und IT-Sicherheit
* **Sprachen & Reisebereitschaft:** Fließendes Deutsch (mind. C1), sehr gutes Englisch sowie Bereitschaft zu 1–2 Klinikbesuchen pro Quartal innerhalb Deutschlands
#### **Warum Caspar Health?**
* Remote-first mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten – Office optional in Berlin Mitte oder 90 Tage im Jahr außerhalb Deutschlands
* Passend dazu, unterstützen wir Dich mit einer monatlichen Homeoffice Pauschale und einem Essenszuschuss on Top
* Genug Zeit zum erholen – mit 30 Tagen Urlaub im Jahr
* Budget für Weiterbildung, Konferenzen & Coaching, passend zu deinen Potentialen und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
* Hohe Eigenverantwortung & Entscheidungsfreiheit: kein Mikromanagement – wir stellen Expert\*innen ein, die wissen was sie tun #MakeAnImpact!
* Echte Zusammenarbeit: keine Silos, keine Eitelkeiten – wir haben schließlich alle die gleiche Vision vor Augen #ValueFocus!
* Zugang zu allen Caspar-Angeboten im Bereich mentale & physische Gesundheit #HealthyTogether!
* Und ja – Alle Snack-Wünsche die das Herz begehrt, gemeinsame Sport-Sessions, ein nie endender Getränke Kühlschrank & eine gute Portion Humor gibt’s auch
**Was uns als Team ausmacht**
-----------------------------
* Wir leben Vielfalt – Diversität ist bei uns kein Aushängeschild, sondern Alltag
* Feedback ist kein Tool, sondern Teil unserer Kultur
* Wir glauben daran, dass Technologie nur dann sinnvoll ist, wenn sie Menschen hilft
* Unser Antrieb ist Purpose – aber unser Anspruch ist Professionalität
### **Lust, Gesundheit neu zu denken?**
Dann freuen wir uns auf Dich!
Bewirb Dich jetzt und werde Teil von Caspar Health. Gemeinsam machen wir den Unterschied.

Elisa

title: Senior Growth Product Manager
description:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.
Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a **Senior Growth Product Manager** to get customers using Soda faster and on more of their data.
### **About Us**
Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.
Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.
### **The Role**
You'll lead our adoption team, a small group of frontend, full-stack, and AI engineers. The team works on onboarding and activation, on keeping workflows coherent across the product, on customer-facing dashboards, and on AI features that save users work.
Most of our roadmap is driven by what customers and prospects ask for. This team's work is driven by adoption metrics, because customers rarely ask for the things that would make them use Soda more. You'll start from a hypothesis, for example that changing a flow will get 20% more data contracts created, ship the change, and check whether it worked.
We sell to enterprises, so sample sizes are small and A/B tests rarely reach significance. You'll use product analytics, session replays, and conversations with users, and you'll often have to decide with incomplete data. This is a product role. If most of your growth experience is in paid acquisition or lifecycle email, it's probably the wrong fit. You'll also work closely with our Growth team, which is led by a co-founder, on launches and messaging.
### **What You'll Do**
* Own the adoption metrics for Soda Cloud: time to first verified contract for new accounts, data coverage (datasets with contracts and monitors), weekly active datasets and users, and usage of AI features. You'll define them, make sure we can measure them, and improve them.
* Own the UX of workflows across the product and keep them coherent for our two kinds of users: data engineers, and business users such as data stewards and governance leads.
* Find where customers get stuck between signing the contract and running Soda on most of their data, and decide what to fix first.
* Design and ship onboarding flows that get a new team to first value within days, including self-serve paths for technical teams that want to evaluate Soda on their own.
* Put AI to work on adoption: decide which steps an agent should do for the user, ship them with the team, and measure whether people keep using them.
* Work with Growth on launches and product marketing, and with our customer engineers on whatever is blocking rollouts at customers.
### **Hiring Process**
* Application: your CV, plus a short answer about one metric you moved (what it was, what you shipped, what happened, and what didn't work)
* 15-minute phone screen
* First interview (60 min): a deep dive into product growth work you've done. Part of it is showing us something you shipped that you'd still be proud to demo.
* Second interview (60 min): a working session on a real Soda adoption problem
* Culture fit (45 min)
We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3–5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.
 **Requirements** 
### **You Should Have**
* **5+ years in product, including at least 2 owning growth, activation, onboarding, or adoption in B2B SaaS**: you were accountable for a metric for long enough to see whether your changes worked. In your application, tell us which metric it was, where it started and where it ended, what you shipped, and what didn't work.
* **Product craft and taste**: you love software and have used a lot of it yourself, so you know what a good product feels like. You keep scope small, work in short cycles with engineers and designers, run your own customer calls, and have well-reasoned opinions about UX.
* **An AI-native way of working and building**: you've shipped an AI-powered feature and measured whether people use it, you prototype with coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.), and you're happy to open a small PR yourself for something like a copy change.

The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a Senior Growth Product Manager to get customers using Soda faster and on more of their data.
 About Us
 Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. You'll start from a hypothesis, for example that changing a flow will get 20% more data contracts created, ship the change, and check whether it worked.
We sell to enterprises, so sample sizes are small and A/B tests rarely reach significance.  Business tools: Familiarity with systems such as Personio, Qonto, Slack, and workflow automation platforms.
 Deep-tech exposure: Experience in robotics, hardware, or another technically complex environment.
 We care more about what you've built and delivered than how many years you've spent doing it.
 What We Offer
 Join coera at a defining stage, where you'll have the opportunity to build the operational foundations of a company working on one of the most important challenges in robotics and Physical AI.
You'll work directly with the founders, gain visibility across the business and take genuine ownership of initiatives that shape how the company operates and grows.
Rather than maintaining established systems, you'll help create them — with the freedom to identify opportunities, challenge existing ways of working and make a tangible impact from day one.
 How We Work
 Small, senior, deliberate. We write more than we meet, challenge ideas openly, and focus on building what matters.
We value people who take ownership, communicate clearly, move quickly and are comfortable navigating ambiguity. We care about quality and attention to detail, but we're equally committed to pragmatic solutions and getting things done.
 process and small print
 Our hiring process
 We aim to keep our process thoughtful, transparent and focused on getting to know each other.
 Initial conversation with our People & Talent team.
 Introductory interview with the Hiring Manager.
 In-person meeting & brainstorming session to explore how you think, approach challenges, and collaborate.
 Stakeholder interview to meet key team members and explore how we'd work together.
 Location
 This is a full-time, on-site role based in Berlin. We're building a close-knit team and believe working together in person makes a real difference at this stage.
 About Us
 coera is building the universal safety intelligence layer for human-robot coexistence, redefining what safety means in the age of physical AI. Robotics is advancing faster than the safety systems meant to support it. coera closes that gap with multimodal sensing and deterministic guardrails: retrofittable, embeddable, controller-agnostic. Safety is not a checkpoint or a constraint. It is the capability that lets intelligent machines operate freely wherever people do.
